comparison.objective: Place glazing setting blocks and stand a glass unit on them; candidate tunes a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Fragile large-panel bimanual handling, edge alignment and controlled load transfer versus small-tool alignment, collar rotation and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Glass supported at required locations and orientation without drop, impact or damage versus two acceptable carriage stops. Candidate omits numeric rebound/overload/drift limits.
comparison.reason: Fragile panel placement and support loading are materially different from damper commissioning.
